# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "ecms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "ecms-theory.html",
    Implementation = "ecms-implementation.html",
    Validation = "ecms-validation.html"
  )
)
```

ECMS is checked against elastic-cylinder FEM references over frequency, orientation, radius/length changes, and elastic material response.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
